claim_boundary: PASS/FAIL adjudicates only the frozen T4C.6 relationship family on this exact ERA5 crop; it is not causality, universality, forecast skill or operational readiness. FAIL is reported only where the derived spatial-power record shows the absence was detectable; where it does not, the run is INVALID and is not a negative finding.

climatology.claim_boundary: climatology fit only; no cross-scale relationship or skill

gate.decision_rule: PASS requires the same positive, q<=alpha relationship in the independent train and test partitions; an adequately powered absence is FAIL, never INVALID

power_adjudication.reason: a PASS verdict is not an absence, and spatial imprecision biases toward the null, so the derived power record cannot overturn it

limitations: the curve is a within-field trend over nested sub-crops of one record, not a set of independent measurements, and nothing infers across sizes
it characterises the single audited test, so it bounds the family's best case rather than every member of it
spatial_power.matched_interior_note: the two scales lose different margins to the same filter, so the curve is measured on the concentric window both interiors can supply. Where those interiors differ, the curve's largest row is therefore not the sweep's own estimate, which used each scale's full interior. Both numbers are reported rather than reconciled, because an adjustment between them would be a correction nothing measured.

crop_requirement.reason: the attenuation curve could not be fitted, so no crop can be named: 1/TE against 1/ESS does not fit the attenuation model well enough (R^2=0.232) to name the effect an unlimited crop would see. The model is a weak-dependence approximation and does not hold near the log(bins) entropy ceiling

family_requirement.reason: reported for review only. Reducing a preregistered family after the data are in is not a remedy, it is how a null result is converted into a finding; the declared 36 tests stand.

minimum_detectable_effect.basis: the 1-th largest of 4999 circular-shift surrogates: the observation must exceed it to leave at most 0 exceedance(s) and clear rank 1 of a 36-test family under benjamini_yekutieli at alpha=0.05
